args: for d in "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" "$PWD" "$HOME/Sites/metravel2/metravel2" "$HOME/PhpstormProjects/metravel2"; do if [ -n "$d" ] && [ -f "$d/.secrets/metravel-task-board.env" ]; then P="$d"; break; fi; done; if [ -z "$P" ]; then echo 'metravel-task-board: .secrets/metravel-task-board.env not found (checked $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR, $PWD, ~/Sites/metravel2/metravel2, ~/PhpstormProjects/metravel2)' >&2; exit 1; fi; for b in "$P/../metravel-backend" "$HOME/Sites/metravel2/metravel-backend" "$HOME/PhpstormProjects/metravel-backend"; do if [ -d "$b/tools/mcp_server" ]; then B="$b"; break; fi; done; if [ -z "$B" ]; then echo 'metravel-task-board: backend checkout with tools/mcp_server not found (checked <project>/../metravel-backend, ~/Sites/metravel2/metravel-backend, ~/PhpstormProjects/metravel-backend)' >&2; exit 1; fi; set -a; . "$P/.secrets/metravel-task-board.env"; set +a; export PYTHONPATH="$B"; exec python3 -m tools.mcp_server

P="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}"; cd "$P" || exit 1; ok() { "$1" -e 'process.exit(Number(process.versions.node.split(".")[0])>=22?0:1)' 2>/dev/null; }; N=; for c in node /opt/homebrew/opt/node@22/bin/node /usr/local/opt/node@22/bin/node; do if command -v "$c" >/dev/null 2>&1 && ok "$c"; then N="$c"; break; fi; done; if [ -z "$N" ]; then echo 'metravel-knowledge: нужен Node >= 22 (node в PATH или brew node@22)' >&2; exit 1; fi; exec "$N" --experimental-strip-types --disable-warning=MODULE_TYPELESS_PACKAGE_JSON scripts/ai-index/mcp.ts
